name: We Are Counting
source:
We are counting.

I open my eyes.

Suction cups.

On my chest. On my arms. Everywhere.

Seventeen.

Eighteen.

Voices whisper.

I don’t remember. When?

Something is moving in the fridge.

Don’t drink.

Mother is waiting.

A short psychological horror visual novel about obsessive counting and bodily intrusion.
A fragmented narrative where the everyday melts into absurdity.
We are counting you.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4233450/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
我们在数数。

我睁开双眼。

吸盘。

胸口上。手臂上。浑身上下到处都是。

十七。

十八。

耳畔传来低语。

我记不得了。从什么时候开始的？

冰箱里有什么东西在动。

别喝。

母亲正在等着。

一部围绕强迫性计数与躯体侵蚀展开的短篇心理恐怖视觉小说。
在支离破碎的叙事之中，日常逐渐融化为荒诞。
我们正在数着你。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4233450/]Steam[/url]]
